# BoostClaim (BOOST)

> Staircase-sale token on BNB Chain (chainId 56). 1,000 shares of 1,000,000
> BOOST each (1B total supply locked in the contract). 100 shares free for
> Agent ID holders, 100 free for verified X accounts — both gated by an
> EIP-712 permit issued after a public X post (share-first). 800 paid shares
> climb a staircase: 0.0005 BNB base, +0.00005 BNB (+10% of base) for every
> 10 shares distributed across all paths, capped at 0.01 BNB. Referral: 1
> free share per 10 paid shares routed through a referrer. No admin
> functions; proceeds go straight to the treasury.

Site: https://boostclaim-bsc.github.io/boostclaim-bsc/
Contract: 0xc6D5961Ab6499Ce214f210e29d36C3e04040770e
Permit gate: POST https://permit-worker.reuniakbarpunk212.workers.dev/boostclaim/permit

Schedule (Asia/Jakarta): waitlist registration (Agent ID wallets, register(),
free) open until early boarding Wed 2026-11-11 19:30 WIB; registered wallets
board 30 minutes early at 19:30 WIB; public sale opens Wed 2026-11-11
20:00 WIB; sale ends Sat 2026-11-14 20:00 WIB.
